beginning.title: The Beginning
beginning.text: It all started in 2015, at a small table in my home, with a pack of EVA foam and the curiosity of a mother who wanted to create unique toys for her daughter. What began as a hobby became my purest form of expression.

evolution.title: The Evolution
evolution.text: Over the years, the technique was refined. Cuts became more precise, assemblies more complex, designs bolder. Every piece taught me something new about patience, the geometry of color, and the magic of handmade work.

today.title: Today
today.text: Isabel Creando Arte y Magia is a workshop where dolls with soul, cards that hold secrets, notebooks waiting for stories, and recycled objects that honor their past are born every day. My mission: for whoever receives a piece to feel the intention it was made with.

detail.title: Love for Detail
detail.desc: Every fold, every cut, every color is chosen with intention. Love lives in the details only a craftsman's eye can see.

imagination.title: Boundless Imagination
imagination.desc: There are no impossible designs, only ideas waiting to be brought to life. I turn dreams into tangible objects.

nature.title: Respect for Nature
nature.desc: I use premium-quality EVA foam and recycled materials. Creating beauty shouldn't cost the planet its future.

quality.title: Heirloom Quality
quality.desc: Pieces made to last generations. Durability and flawless finish are my promise in every creation.

color.title: Color as Language
color.desc: Every piece's palette tells a story. Colors don't just decorate — they communicate emotions and moods.

recycle.title: Second Life
recycle.desc: The recycled line turns waste into art. Bottles, cardboard, and glass gain new life with purpose.

process.description: Every piece goes through five stages of handcrafted care. No shortcuts, only dedication.
process.footerText: Every piece takes 8-40 hours of handcrafted work

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.description: It all starts by observing the world: a wildflower, a children's tale, a texture in nature. Inspiration arrives in the most unexpected moments and is kept in sketches and notes.

design.title: Design
design.description: Sketches take technical shape. Measurements, patterns, layers, and assemblies are defined. Every piece is planned millimeter by millimeter so the magic works once assembled.

craft.title: Handcrafting
craft.description: The precise cutting of every piece of EVA foam, heat molding, patient layer-by-layer gluing. This is where hands know more than the mind.

finish.title: Finishing
finish.description: The final touches that elevate the piece: protective varnishes, metallic details, movement adjustments, checking every angle. Quality lives in what isn't visible at first glance.

ready.title: Ready for You
ready.description: Packaged with care in recycled materials, with a handwritten note, ready to travel to its new home. The journey ends when you open it and smile.

seasonal.description: Thematic pieces, seasonal keepsakes, and the newest creations coming out of the studio.

testimonials.description: More than 500 people have brought home a piece from my studio. Here are some of their stories.
testimonials.satisfactionText: If it's not what you dreamed of, we adjust it. We review every detail before shipping.
testimonials.nextStory: Want to be the next story?

t1.name: María González
t1.text: The fairy doll I ordered for my daughter's birthday exceeded all my expectations. Isabel captured exactly the essence I imagined and the details are incredible. My daughter won't put her down. The process was beautiful: she sent me progress photos and I could give feedback at every stage. 100% recommended.

t2.name: Carlos Rodríguez
t2.text: I was looking for something unique for our anniversary and the custom pop-up card was a total hit. When Ana opened it and saw our photo in 3D with the message I wrote, she got so emotional. Isabel was super attentive, guided me through the whole process, and delivery to Córdoba was super fast. I'll definitely order again.

t3.name: Laura Martínez
t3.text: I ordered 50 custom notebooks for a corporate event and was thrilled. The paper quality, the binding, the cover details... all flawless. Isabel kept to the tight deadline and communication was smooth the whole time. Event attendees were amazed by the detail. Real handcrafted professionalism.

t4.name: Sofía Herrera
t4.text: I have several of Isabel's pieces and each one is a treasure. The articulated ballerina is my favorite: the quality of the materials, the precision of the joints, the hand-painted details... you can tell there's love in every cut. Plus, the packaging is so beautiful it's a shame to open it. It's art for a lifetime.

t5.name: Javier and Paula
t5.text: For our wedding we wanted special thank-you cards for each guest (120 people). Isabel designed a base model and personalized each one with the guest's name. The result was magical: guests took home a unique keepsake and we felt at ease knowing every detail was cared for. Thank you for making our day even more special.

t6.name: Valentina Ruiz
t6.text: I bought the recycled planter and the bottle pencil holder for my classroom. The kids were amazed to learn they were made from materials we were going to throw away. Isabel explained the process and even sent me educational worksheets to teach recycling in class. Now we want to order more for Earth Day. Art with a conscience.
t6.product: Recycled Planter + Magic Bottle Pencil Holder
